notes:
# Blackline 0.15.142

* **Links arrive as proper embeds.** A video, a photograph, a listing, an article — the card is now
  drawn from what the page says it is, so a YouTube link comes with its thumbnail, the play glyph
  and how long it runs; a photo or a listing comes with its picture across the card; a plain link
  keeps the small square. It works for any site that describes itself, which is nearly all of them,
  rather than for a list of sites somebody had to write down.
* Settings → Chat → "Play videos in the card" (off by default). On, the play button plays it here;
  that asks YouTube for the video from your device, so they learn your address and that you
  watched. Off, it opens in your browser as it always has. Nothing on a card reaches anybody unless
  you turn this on.
* A picture that could not be squeezed under the size a message will carry used to be dropped
  altogether, so some cards arrived with no picture at all; and a logo with a transparent
  background arrived as a black square. Both fixed.
* **The pinned card is back.** Clicking a card in a call opens it across the stage with everybody
  else beside it as a rail of small ones. It was turned off because it looked broken — one CSS rule
  meant for the opened card was also catching every card in the rail and flattening them.
* Everyone needs this version to talk to everyone else; the app updates itself.
